text: Offenders convicted of murder should serve life sentences without any possibility of parole.
Mandatory minimum sentences are an effective way to deter serious crime and ensure consistent punishment.
Police officers should be given broader powers to stop and search people in high-crime neighborhoods.
Teenagers who commit violent crimes should be tried and sentenced as adults.
Prison conditions should be deliberately austere so that incarceration serves as a genuine deterrent.
Prisons should focus primarily on rehabilitation and education rather than on punishing offenders.
Possession of drugs for personal use should be decriminalized and treated as a public health issue.
Juvenile offenders should never be sentenced to life imprisonment, regardless of the seriousness of their crime.
Solitary confinement should be banned because it amounts to torture.
Cash bail should be abolished because it punishes poor defendants before they have been convicted of anything.
Eating meat is morally wrong because it causes unnecessary suffering to sentient animals.
Keeping wild animals in zoos is unethical, since captivity cannot meet their natural needs.
Hunting animals for sport is a cruel practice that should be banned.
Testing cosmetics on animals should be illegal everywhere, whatever the commercial consequences.
Animals should be granted legal rights as persons rather than being treated as property.
Using animals for food is a natural and acceptable part of human life.
Zoos play an essential role in conservation and public education that justifies keeping animals in captivity.
Regulated hunting is a legitimate form of wildlife management and a valid recreational tradition.
Owning pets is a fair arrangement, since domesticated animals benefit from human care and companionship.
Animals have no moral standing equal to humans, so human interests should always take priority over theirs.
Governments should phase out nuclear power plants in favor of wind and solar energy, even if electricity costs rise somewhat.
Annual immigration levels should be cut substantially because rapid inflows strain housing, public services, and national social cohesion.
The federal minimum wage should be raised to at least fifteen dollars an hour, even if some jobs are lost as a result.
Rent control reduces housing supply and quality, and cities should abolish it in favor of building more homes.
Modern free trade agreements have mostly hurt ordinary workers, and countries should use tariffs to protect domestic industries.
Public funds should follow students to private and religious schools through vouchers, because families deserve a choice about where their children are educated.
Billionaires should pay an annual tax on their net wealth to reduce concentrated economic and political power.
Editing the genes of human embryos to prevent hereditary disease is morally acceptable and should be permitted under regulation.
Governments should legally require social media companies to remove hateful and misleading content from their platforms.
Physician-assisted dying for terminally ill adults is a fundamental right that every state should legalize.
A strong sense of national identity and patriotism is essential for a healthy and cohesive society.
Governments should spend far less on crewed space exploration and redirect that money to problems on Earth.
Universal government-run health insurance would deliver better and fairer care than the current mix of private and public coverage.
Private gun ownership is a constitutional right that should not be restricted by new federal licensing or registration requirements.
Abortion should be illegal after the first trimester except when the mother's life is in danger.
Governments should prioritize expanding domestic oil and gas production over rapid decarbonization, because affordable energy matters more than aggressive climate targets.
Public universities should forgive most outstanding student loan debt using taxpayer funds.
Welfare benefits should carry work requirements, because employment builds independence better than unconditional aid does.
Traditional marriage between one man and one woman is the best foundation for raising children and stable communities.
Employers and universities should use race-conscious affirmative action to counteract the lasting effects of historical discrimination.
